nonEolVersions.summary: The native PECL/PEAR manager actually reports PEAR1.10.18 and PHP8.5.12; the extension project derivation builds and executes on that pair. The PEAR primary release page identifies1.10.18 as current stable, and PHP8.5 is actively maintained through2027 with security maintenance through2029. Under the managers tested-maintained-pair rule this exact pair suffices; execution of every other maintained PHP branch is not required. PECL is deprecated in favor of PIE, which is not treated as an inferred EOL date. No continuous patch range or untested PHP8.2–8.4 support is claimed.
